title: Ericsson Research expands in India to help shape 6G and beyond
summary:
• India has rapidly deployed 5G and is emerging as a key proving ground for 6G, where future use cases will be shaped through collaboration across diverse stakeholders – industry, academia, standards bodies and government.
  • To influence and learn, Ericsson Research is expanding into radio access network research in India and deepening its partnerships with universities, operators and the Bharat 6G Alliance.
